description: A network of caves beneath the ancient Thornwood forest. Something is driving the wildlife mad, turning once-docile creatures into savage predators.

encounter_waves.name: Vermin Nest
encounter_waves.description: Giant rats scurry out of the undergrowth, baring yellowed fangs.

encounter_waves.name: Spider Den
encounter_waves.description: Webs thick as rope crisscross the passage. Shapes move in the darkness above.

encounter_waves.name: Wolf Pack
encounter_waves.description: A pack of dire wolves blocks the path, their alpha howling a challenge.

encounter_waves.name: Scorpion Pit
encounter_waves.description: The ground is littered with bones. Giant scorpions emerge from burrows, pincers snapping.

encounter_waves.name: The Bear's Domain
encounter_waves.description: A massive cave bear guards its territory, roaring as you approach.

encounter_waves.name: The Brood Mother
encounter_waves.description: A cave spider the size of a horse descends from the ceiling, flanked by her swarm.

boss.pre_battle_text: The tunnel opens into a vast underground cavern. The stench of death is overwhelming. In the center, a creature of nightmarish proportions gnaws on the remains of something large.
boss.intro_dialogue: Goremaw lifts its head, blood dripping from rows of teeth. It doesn't roar — it just stares, sizing you up like prey.
boss.victory_text: Goremaw collapses with a ground-shaking thud. The cave falls eerily silent — the beasts of the Thornwood will trouble the surface no more.
boss.defeat_text: Goremaw's jaws close with terrible finality...
